notes:
The database engine behind Corylus's search index has been updated. The older one could hand back stray fragments of the program's own memory while reading an index file that had been tampered with - which only mattered if your project folder sat somewhere another person could write to, such as a shared cloud folder. Your writing was never reachable that way, but the hole is closed now.

The compression code, the window framework and the editor underneath Corylus have all moved up to their latest versions, picking up their own fixes along the way. Nothing you see or do has changed.

macOS: Corylus is not notarized yet, so Gatekeeper may say the app cannot be opened because the developer cannot be verified. Right-click (or Control-click) Corylus.app, choose Open, then Open again. Only needed once per downloaded copy.
